text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a global-scale modeling study analyzing the impact of future land-cover changes on surface dry deposition of ozone and nitric acid. The paper does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation as a primary research question. Instead, it uses existing RCP scenario-based LULC projections as inputs to assess their impact on atmospheric chemistry. There is no national-scale spatial implementation or quantitative accuracy assessment of LULC predictions. The study lacks core inclusion criteria such as primary focus on LULC prediction, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, or mapped LULC projections for national scales. It is also not a review article.)
